payload.text: ISSUE:0680 after WP-09 (vc, in 3.3.0, size M): measure the cause first (a session file read mid-rewrite is a hypothesis); then (1) slots::caller tells unreadable from absent and re-reads a bounded count before refusing, with a remedy that says which; (2) release is accepted from the session id its start.json recorded; (3) the desk shows a start with no end whose asker is alive.
